title: Predicting Early Outcomes of Prostatic Artery Embolization Using n-Butyl Cyanoacrylate Liquid Embolic Agent: A Machine Learning Study
summary: A TabPFN model predicted 7-week symptom-score response after prostatic-artery embolization in 109 retrospective patients (AUROC 0.821) under repeated internal cross-validation; this is a narrow short-term prediction result, not evidence of treatment benefit or external validity.
ai_technology: TabPFN learns from clinical and procedural features to classify six-week IPSS response

evidence.tested: A TabPFN model predicted 7-week symptom-score response after prostatic-artery embolization in 109 retrospective patients (AUROC 0.821) under repeated internal cross-validation; this is a narrow short-term prediction result, not evidence of treatment benefit or external validity.
evidence.unknown: The findings are limited to the reported dataset, experimental setup and validation described in the source; broader generalization and real-world benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: TabPFN learns from clinical and procedural features to classify six-week IPSS response
